title: A header or query shape that admits absence applies to the member, outside the one-element list.
why: behavioural spec 'request': a helper whose node admits absence is the exception to the name-to-list rule, because absence is a fact about the member and not about the value in it — the list treatment applies inside the modifier, never to it. 'forbidden' becomes the member's shape directly; 'optional(of)' becomes an 'optional' whose 'of' is the 'each-like' the rule would otherwise have built. Wrapping instead would put a node admitting absence in an 'each-like's 'items', which shape spec §5.1 refuses, so the natural spelling would build a document the engine rejects.
